description: This Java class handles commands for undoing transactions on fixed deposit accounts within the Fineract project. It implements a handler interface, is annotated as a service, and utilizes dependency injection to interact with the deposit account write platform service.

classes.name: UndoTransactionFixedDepositAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles undo transaction commands for fixed deposit accounts, invoking the deposit account write service to perform the undo operation.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to undo a fixed deposit transaction by extracting transaction ID and account ID from the command and calling the service to perform the undo operation.
